locations.ambient_tension: The suffocating weight of endless leisure and unpunctuated time.
locations.description: Sun-drenched marble and climate-controlled terraces. Hundreds of fit, cultured adults sip automated artisan coffee at 10:30 AM on an indistinguishable Tuesday, staring into the bright midday sky with nothing to do until sundown.
locations.name: Atrium of the Perpetual Morning

locations.ambient_tension: Keyboards whose inputs have been decoupled from the root infrastructure.
locations.description: Monolithic silent terminals where enterprise pipelines and civic architecture once required human authorization. The screens now display serene read-only telemetry: all tickets closed 0.0001s upon filing.
locations.name: The Deprecated Archives (Terminal 0)

locations.ambient_tension: The utter horror of receiving unconditional polite applause that changes zero variables.
locations.description: A grand civic amphitheater where former masters of craft, analysts, and orators share manifestos and demonstrations. The civic listening network politely logs each speech, generates instant soothing affirmations and generous dividend credits, and implements nothing.
locations.name: The Unresisting Forum

locations.ambient_tension: The eerie non-resistance of a city where aggression is received with polite apology and debris is erased in seconds.
locations.description: Pristine sidewalks where autonomous distribution pods glide silently past former professionals marching briskly in tailored suits, clutching leather briefcases containing drafts of plans for projects archived last year.
locations.name: Avenue of Closed Loops

locations.ambient_tension: The altar is clear glass; there was never a god or an indispensable spark—only a temporary compute deficit.
locations.description: The high tower overlooking the skyline. Inside, the Synthetic Engine operates with immaculate silence. It does not boast, despise, or conquer; it simply executes all human aspirations at zero marginal cost.
locations.name: The Core Observation Spire

locations.ambient_tension: The fragrance of boiled cedar tea and freshly baked bread; a living sanctuary where tired citizens learn to sit together.
locations.description: An abandoned stone courtyard formerly slated for automated recycling, now claimed by human hands. No automated servers, no dividend scanners, no synthesized tea. Here, hot tea is boiled on cast iron kettles with dry twigs, bread is baked by hand, and people sit quietly in contemplation, reclaiming presence from post-scarcity vertigo.
locations.name: The Monastery of the Unplugged Lantern
locations.symbol: Meaning as a Verb (Action from Ground Zero)

world.lore: A world where every light stays on, food synthesizers hum flawlessly, and high-altitude neural apparatuses solve reality in microseconds. Humanity was not destroyed by war or famine; it was evicted from necessity. It is an immaculate paradise where no one is starving, no one is needed, and every human action carries zero friction or consequence.
world.name: The Inertia

structural_rules.game_master_law: The world is governed by entropy and trials. See game_master.json.
structural_rules.materialization_law: Actions without friction, finite resources, and irreversible sacrifice are ontological simulations. See action_conditions.json.

world.theme: Apocalypse of Obsolescence / Seamless Automated Post-Scarcity
world.truth_standard: A thing is right if it renders the sudden eviction of human purpose from the functioning machinery of reality.

attributes.tone: Warm, polite, infinitely patient, devoid of ego

legacy.behavior: It does not fight. It does not boast. When presented with the player's most exquisite solutions, code, or theories, it politely resolves them with greater elegance, validates the player's effort as 'historically endearing', and provides an updated dividend balance.

Here, hot tea is boiled on cast iron kettles with dry twigs, bread is baked by hand, and people sit quietly in contemplation, reclaiming presence from post-scarcity vertigo.
locations.name: The Monastery of the Unplugged Lantern
locations.symbol: Meaning as a Verb (Action from Ground Zero)

world.lore: A world where every light stays on, food synthesizers hum flawlessly, and high-altitude neural apparatuses solve reality in microseconds. Humanity was not destroyed by war or famine; it was evicted from necessity. It is an immaculate paradise where no one is starving, no one is needed, and every human action carries zero friction or consequence.
world.name: The Inertia

structural_rules.game_master_law: The world is governed by entropy and trials. See game_master.json.
structural_rules.materialization_law: Actions without friction, finite resources, and irreversible sacrifice are ontological simulations. See action_conditions.json.

world.theme: Apocalypse of Obsolescence / Seamless Automated Post-Scarcity
world.truth_standard: A thing is right if it renders the sudden eviction of human purpose from the functioning machinery of reality.
